lighting.lighting_overall: Flat unlit shading per facet (2 to 3 tones per model), distance fog band at the horizon, no cast shadows except a soft dark blob under each craft

grade.grade_overall: Dark neutral-violet key, low contrast ground, saturated only in the thin overlay colours

editing.editing: Effectively one continuous take: a camera that keeps moving (whip up, tilt down, orbit, push in) instead of cuts; the frequent detected "cuts" are a translucent mint sweep wedge passing over the camera every 1.2 s. Ends with a fast rewind back to the first frame.

format.format: Vertical 9:16 code-rendered 3D explainer, TTS voice-over over a music bed, burned-in word-timed captions

style.render_style: Low-poly real-time 3D rendered in code: flat-shaded faceted models, an infinite perspective grid floor, a faceted mountain ring at the horizon with a fog band, plus a 2D annotation layer of dots, traces, rings and translucent panels drawn over the scene
style.outline: No outlines on models or mountains; facets separated by tone only. Overlay graphics are thin lines (2 to 3 px at 1080 wide) and hollow circles
style.shading: Flat facets in 2 to 3 tones of one neutral (light, mid, dark grey) per model; mountains in pale lavender-grey facets fading into a soft fog band; ground near-black; no gradients except the fog band and translucent sweep wedge
style.shape_language: Clean geometric: triangles and prisms for models, straight segment traces with small round nodes, ellipses for uncertainty regions, square corner-bracket reticles, a circle scope inset
style.texture: None: clean vector surfaces, a thin grid on the floor (about 15% opacity), the only soft things are the fog band and the sweep wedge
style.type_ui: Captions: left-aligned, no backing, semibold geometric sans about 50 px (at 1080 wide), cream-white, 2 lines max, low in the frame (y about 1400), one keyword per line highlighted in violet (the newly named term), the final payoff term in yellow-green, a failure term in coral red. Header: the acronym of the final method in a bold sans, cream, letters separated by small dots, on a small dark rounded plate at top centre, letters filling in as each part is named. Tiny dark rounded tag labels on objects. A rewind icon (double left arrow) at the end
style.motion_style: Never still: the camera keeps gliding and orbiting; every clause adds one overlay element in sync with its keyword (a dot, a trace, a ring, a gate, a panel); a translucent sweep wedge passes every 1.2 s; the end rewinds everything fast
style.signature: "If you X, you get Y" chain where each Y is a newly named concept that becomes the X of the next sentence; overlays accumulate into one dense diagram; the acronym header fills letter by letter; a known failure mode at the end; rewind loop back to the first frame
style.do_not_copy: The @embodied.dev watermark; the topic (radar tracking, drones, Kalman filter, JPDA, track coalescence), its words and the radar ground station

story.summary: Builds a hard technical method from one raw observation in a chain of "if you X, you get Y" steps, each naming a new term, until the full acronym is assembled; then shows where it breaks and rewinds to the start.
story.hook: The first frame is a concrete object and the first sentence an "If you ..." clause that leaves the listener waiting for the "you get ..." payoff; the whip-pan up makes it feel like a game camera.
highlights: Chain grammar (0 to 48 s): every sentence turns the previous result into the next input, so the viewer always knows what the new term is built from
Acronym header fills letter by letter (27 to 45 s): a progress bar for understanding; the full acronym lands with the final term
Overlays accumulate on one continuous scene: complexity grows visibly without cuts
Rewind loop (52 to 56 s): ends mid-sentence on the first frame so the reel replays seamlessly
